data.title: Kane tipped to beat Yamal, Mbappe to Ballon d'Or glory
data.description: LONDON - Harry Kane has been called the favourite to become England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years when the award is presented in London on Monday, but he faces stiff competition from La Liga pair Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.

data.title: Kane primed to pip Yamal, Mbappe to Ballon d'Or glory
data.description: LONDON - England captain Harry Kane is the favourite to win a wide open race to be crowned Ballon d'Or winner at a glitzy London ceremony on Monday, with Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe also in the running to be named the world's best footballer.

data.title: Chiefs and 49ers suffer first losses of NFL season, Vikings stay unbeaten
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The Seattle Seahawks put on a defensive masterclass to hand the Kansas City Chiefs their first defeat of the NFL season on Sunday, winning 20-3, while the San Francisco 49ers also surrendered their perfect start to the Atlanta Falcons.

data.title: Antonelli wins US Grand Prix to close on world title
data.description: AUSTIN - Kimi Antonelli moved to within striking distance of his first world championship title as he powered to an emphatic victory at the US Grand Prix in Austin on Sunday.

data.title: Mbappe double helps Real Madrid stun Barca in La Liga Clasico
data.description: BARCELONA - Kylian Mbappe struck twice to earn Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid a 2-1 Clasico victory over La Liga leaders Barcelona on Sunday at Camp Nou, cutting the gap to three points.

data.title: Tiger March passes toughest test to claim WBA Asia South title
data.description: When you look at Siriyakorn Chamjaiharn, better known as Tiger March, you see a 15-year-old kid with blonde hair whose father is a former guitarist of the prominent Thai pop-rock band Potato. Boxing might not be the first thing that comes to mind, but the youngster is already making a name for himself inside the professional ring.

data.title: Minnows shock Buriram in Isan derby
data.description: Defending champions Buriram United suffered their first defeat of the Thai League 1 season on Saturday night, beaten 3-2 at home by northeastern rivals Sisaket United in a derby that few had seen coming.

data.title: Carrick on the brink as Man Utd misery mounts, Isak stars for Liverpool
data.description: LONDON - Michael Carrick was pushed to the brink of being sacked after Manchester United slumped to a miserable 3-0 home defeat against Bournemouth, while Alexander Isak extended his hot streak in Liverpool's 2-0 win against Brighton on Sunday.

data.title: Quartet in race for Hong Kong crown
data.description: HONG KONG: The final round of the Hong Kong Open is set for a titanic battle today after American John Catlin and Anirban Lahiri from India, both former Asian Tour No.1s and multiple tournament winners, Belgium star Thomas Pieters and Caleb Surratt, the United States golfer who is one of the hottest young players in the game, took the third-round lead.

data.title: Man City's perfect start ended by Aston Villa, Arsenal go joint-top
data.description: LONDON - Manchester City's flawless start to the Premier League season was ended in a 2-1 defeat at Aston Villa on Saturday that allowed Arsenal to join them at the top of the table with victory over Everton.

data.title: Thais fall short as Asian Para Games end in Japan
data.description: The para fencing team clinched their third gold medal of the fifth Asian Para Games on the last day of competition as the Thai contingent ended their Aichi-Nagoya 2026 campaign with 19 gold, 40 silver and 66 bronze medals and were seventh in the overall medal standings.

data.title: Tottenham Hotspur finally end long wait for a win
data.description: There was a huge sigh of relief at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on Monday night when Spurs notched their first league win of the season after seven games. Their 3-1 victory over Coventry City lifted them off the bottom of the table to a slightly more comfortable 16th place.

data.title: Hot Buriram braced for derby test
data.description: Thai League 1 leaders Buriram United will take on Sisaket United in the northeastern derby at Chang Arena today.

data.title: Cheung halfway to historic victory, Jazz tied for third
data.description: HONG KONG: Matthew Cheung has set up a thrilling weekend of golf for Hong Kong's golf fans after taking the halfway lead in the Hong Kong Open as he attempts to become the first player from the territory to win the prestigious title in its 65-year history.

data.title: Pornpawee falls in Paris
data.description: Thailand's challenge ended in the last 16 of the US$950,000 BWF French Open in Paris on Thursday night.

data.title: Saysunee lands gold, Pongsakorn sizzles
data.description: Wheelchair fencer Saysunee Jana finally struck gold at the Asian Para Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026, while wheelchair racer Pongsakorn Paeyo set a Games record for a third straight 400m title, on the penultimate day of competition in Japan on Friday.

data.title: Asian football body makes U-turn, endorses Infantino
data.description: TOKYO - The head of Asian football said on Friday that the region supported Gianni Infantino’s bid for re-election as Fifa president, weeks after stinging criticism over his aborted World Cup sell-off plan.

data.title: ONE Championship releases five fighters, including Luo Chao and ‘Wondergirl’
data.description: ONE Championship has released five fighters from its roster, including Chinese kickboxer Luo Chao and Thai fighter Nat “Wondergirl” Jaroonsak, the Bangkok Post understands.

data.title: Man U skipper Carrick already on borrowed time
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - Beset by infighting and off to their worst league start for decades, Manchester United host Bournemouth needing to snap a seven-game winless run to quell talk of another mid-season managerial change.

data.title: Buriram ace Bissoli bags month's gong
data.description: Buriram United striker Guilherme Bissoli was named Thai League 1 player of the month for September, while Rayong's Akkraporn Chalittaporn won the coach of the month award.

data.title: Bournemouth hammer 10-man Milan, Juventus denied at the death
data.description: PARIS - Bournemouth pulled off a sensational 3-0 home victory over 10-man AC Milan on Thursday to make it three wins from their opening three games in the Europa League.

data.title: Stars shine in pool and on road
data.description: Thai para athletes made a big splash in the Aichi-Nagoya pool and burned rubber on the road to add two more gold medals to the Thai haul at the 2026 Asian Para Games on Thursday.

data.title: Thai players face uphill battle against Switzerland
data.description: Thailand will face a formidable test against Switzerland in the 2026 Billie Jean King Cup Playoff World Group tie next month.

data.title: ONE Championship: Itsuki Hirata finds her way back with revenge over Jihin
data.description: Four years and seven months after Jihin Radzuan handed her a first professional defeat, Itsuki Hirata finally had her revenge. After everything that followed that night in Singapore, she also had reason to believe her career was moving forward again.
